Metadata.title: BeachRex - Find your perfect beach.
Metadata.description: All the beaches of the world in one place. For every tourist to find his or hers perfect beach for their earned vacation. This is the vision of BeachRex that I dedicated 4 years of my life to. During this time that I've travelled, I've created world's largest database of photos, videos, panoramas, sperichal photos and data on beaches of Spain, France, Slovenia, Croatia and Italy. Currently, I am creating a final website and mobile application with a complete presentation of all 2.445 beaches, 56.000 photos, videos, panoramas, spherical photos and 200 detailed data e.g. charasteristics of every beach. BeachRex's vision is that within few years we will obtain photos and other data for all the beaches of the world. If you love beaches and you like BeachRex's idea please support us and share our site with your friends.

AuthorPage.metaTitle: Gregor Balažic – the author of Beachrex
AuthorPage.metaDescription: Meet Gregor Balažic, who quit his job, bought a camera and a van and visited 4,000 beaches in 13 countries. Beachrex grew out of his journey.
AuthorPage.lead: “Beaches have always been my great passion.”

leap.title: Leaving the comfort zone
leap.text: Beaches have always been my great passion, says Gregor Balažic, who quit his job. He was a head of department; he stepped out of his comfort zone and left a predictable future behind. He bought a camera and a van, which became his new home, and set off into the world. To the beaches, to be precise.

road.title: <beaches>4,000 beaches</beaches> in <countries>13 countries</countries>
road.text: He travelled along the coasts and beaches of <countries>13 countries</countries>: <list></list>. He visited no fewer than <beaches>4,000 beaches</beaches>. The number may seem huge, but it is only a drop in the ocean – there are more than 200,000 beaches in the world suitable for tourism, Balažic explains.

database.title: The world’s largest beach database
database.text: The beaches he visited became the foundation of the world’s largest beach database – Beachrex. Every beach comes with photos, panoramic shots, videos, information about parking, GPS location, weather data, accommodation, sports activities, restaurants and bars, and sea temperature. Altogether that is more than 200 details about every beach.

hardships.title: The road was not always easy
hardships.text: Balažic has travelled more than 70,000 kilometres, and sometimes he even had to climb to get the perfect shot. The journey of thousands of kilometres was not always bathed in sunshine – there were unpleasant moments along the way, and he was robbed several times. But his journey is not over (yet).
